_: What two mates who are friends can do together (docs/mate-social.md). match: which activity of her own day it is (by place or body; else she is simply out, at the other one's place). hours: when it can start; minutes: how long. remote: each stays at home (a call, a game online). outdoor: not in rain or snow. body: what her avatar does there when her own day has nothing like it. shared: what both remember; own: what only she knows of it ({a} {b} are their names; {a:과} picks the particle).
